verdict.rationale: LightSprint is a SaaS AI development platform, so outbound webhook subscriptions are a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Two-way sync with Slack, Linear and Jira, and MCP integrations, are adjacent features that do not qualify as webhooks, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
